trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and says the root cause needs to be found before v2.3.1 is deployed again. My first attempt to create it timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key, which stops it being created twice. The incident list shows only one incident.
